correctness.rationale: Direct Ewens factorial-moment extraction for distinct sizes 1,2,3 gives E[product C_j]=θ^r/(product j) W_sum j, with W_k=(n)_k/(n+θ-1)_k, and inclusion–exclusion gives the five-term cumulant. An independent symbolic computation verified the COMPLETE rational identity in formal n,θ: five-term expression equals 6n(n-1)(n-2)(θ-1)Q_n(θ) divided by the displayed strictly positive product of ten linear factors. Since Q_n(0),Q_n(2)<0 for all integer n>=6, Q_n″>0 on θ>=0 and Q_n′(2)>0, Q_n has precisely one zero above 2; Q_n(3)=-n(n-6)(n-3)(2n+1). Expansion at θ=(2/5)n+d gives n^3 coefficient 7(35d-24)/25, hence d=24/35 and O(n^-1) by a simple implicit root. Symbolic identity also tested at n=6,7,9,11; finite tests are corroboration, not proof.
